source_revision: The commit containing this evidence directory

minio.build: go install github.com/minio/minio@v0.0.0-20250907161309-07c3a429bfed; built locally from pinned official source, not a release binary

environment.proxy_scope: HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY/ALL_PROXY removed case-insensitively from the command subprocess environment only; global configuration unchanged

scope: Single-domain Gateway.CreateSubtask accepts strict unsigned anet.subtask-intent/1 JSON over registered-instance mTLS. Shared root/child durable ID binding and server signature/expiry, independent TCS delegation checks, no fresh root permit, nested cross-subject flow through cancellation/closeout, conflict and expiry preservation, and post-INSERT identity/certificate/command-expiry rechecks for both ingress methods. No new schema migration. Complete contract/VERIFIED validation, UpdateTaskStatus, recipient-policy management, full Python SDK, HTTPS/JSON edge, agentgateway/OAuth/DPoP/disclosure/quota enforcement and cross-domain protocols remain pending. Benchmark covers existing root control paths, not child delegation latency or production capacity.
development_note: Initial targeted run failed because the new gw.command_bound audit fault constraint also invalidated the already existing root signing audit. The fault now targets only the child command; corrected audit and post-insert-wait tests passed. First full run passed the new gateway tests but failed the existing renewal process test before watch_due could start: Windows returned sharing violation 32 for instancerenew.exe, followed by TempDir cleanup failure. That run is not counted as passed. After termination no instancerenew process was observed and a DELETE-access probe succeeded without deleting the executable. The test now retries Start only for Windows error 32 with Cmd.Process still nil, rebuilding the command each time within five seconds. A successfully started command and its Wait result/assertions are never retried. Cleanup only retries the same sharing error within five seconds after child waits. Other errors and exhausted bounds still fail. Updated sources were frozen and a new isolated cluster passed all 40 gates, MinIO and microbenchmark; all clusters stopped.
expanded_process_test: TestRPCDaemonProcess now kills the shipped anetd before child signing commit and after signing commit while waiting for TCS acceptance, then recovers one child and verifies the accepted receipt across another process restart.
